title: Tight Collision Bounds for Davies–Meyer and Group-1 PGV Functions
summary: In the quantum ideal-cipher model, the known collision bound for Davies–Meyer and group-1 PGV functions is non-tight; determining a tight bound remains open.

formal_statement.body: Improve the $O(q^4/2^n)$ collision bound for Davies--Meyer and group-1 PGV functions to a tight bound.

scope.domain: Quantum collision resistance of Davies–Meyer and group-1 PGV compression functions.
parameters: q: quantum-query count in the collision bound
n: block-length parameter in the collision bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine a tight collision bound for Davies–Meyer and group-1 PGV functions in the quantum ideal-cipher model.

citations.label: Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers

progress.summary: The source proves a quantitative collision-resistance bound for group-1 PGV compression functions in the quantum ideal-cipher model, then states that it is non-tight relative to BHT quantum collision finding.
citation_labels: Alexandru Cojocaru et al., Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers
